canonical_project: Bac Ninh Smart City Data Center (Trung tâm dữ liệu thành phố thông minh, VND 570bn)
owner: Bac Ninh Department of Information and Communications
notes: Provincial smart-city data center project (~VND 570 billion incl. cloud and integration platforms) under the Bac Ninh ICT department; announced September 2017 and still referenced as planned investment in 2023. No large commercial/hyperscale data center identified in Bac Ninh despite its VSIP and electronics industrial zones.
